n = int(input())
line = input()

builder = []
countInParentheses = 0
index = 0

while index < len(line):
    if line[index] == '(':
        builder.append('_')
        index += 1
        inside = []
        while line[index] != ')':
            inside.append(line[index])
            index += 1
        wordsInside = ''.join(inside).split('_')
        for word in wordsInside:
            if word:
                countInParentheses += 1
    else:
        builder.append(line[index])
    index += 1

parts = ''.join(builder).split('_')
maxWordLength = 0
for part in parts:
    if part and len(part) > maxWordLength:
        maxWordLength = len(part)

print(f"{maxWordLength} {countInParentheses}")
